description: Add a countdown to a date the user named (a race, a trip, a test) to their telo home. telo counts days; it never judges them.

color.description: Only when the user asks for a color. Omit to use telo's default for the metric's category

question.description: The user's question or request that led to this card, in their words

size.description: half: two consecutive half cards share a row, as a number and a small trend line. Default full

title.description: What the person is counting down to, in their words: '10K race'

name: pin_countdown
title: Pin a countdown to the telo home
